method: Assistant visually inspected each original retained PNG at indices 0 through 16 using image viewing, separately from the automated artifact audit.
positive_prompt: A sunlit interior with warm plaster walls, a wooden door, limestone flooring, brass details, and green plants.
layout: The closed wooden door, wall-panel divisions, floor-tile seams and left window remain recognizable and in the same arrangement throughout all 17 frames.
color: Warm beige plaster and flooring, brown wood, muted gold door details and pale blue window light remain stable. The severe prismatic colored distortion seen in the earlier reduced-size clips is not visible in this clip.
motion: The clip is nearly static. Minor edge, texture and brightness changes are visible; there is no clear door opening, object movement or purposeful camera movement.
detail: Edges and surfaces remain somewhat soft, particularly around the door trim and wall texture. This is not evidence of additional scene detail beyond the conditioned render.
prompt_alignment: The visible interior, wooden door, pale stone-like floor and gold details match those parts of the saved prompt. Green plants requested in the prompt are not visible.
limitations: Passing the artifact audit verifies saved bytes, tensors, records and pixel mappings. The visual observations are a separate qualitative assessment of this one clip.
The short, nearly static clip does not demonstrate action control, sustained motion, physical consistency, persistent memory, diverse scene quality or Genie 3 parity.

The spatial input was resized and cropped from the same original render, and a fresh CUDA observation was encoded. This result alone does not isolate spatial resolution as the cause of improvement over earlier runs.
The successful appearance uses an attributed external pretrained foundation. No original-model or research-novelty claim follows from this result.
